Amid midterm elections, the Trump administration is considering capital gains tax cuts, with the wealthiest as the biggest beneficiaries. headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 分红、回购、增持常态化推进，A股公司以实际行动稳市场强信心
headlines.summary: 时值A股上市公司半年报披露窗口期，上市公司公告中期利润分配方案的案例渐次增多；同时，从回购、增持动作密集的情况看，上市公司回馈投资者意识显著增强。分析人士认为，中期分红落地数量扩容、注销式回购规模扩大、大手笔增持传递发展信心，叠加相关配套政策工具落地，上市公司正以实际行动提振市场信心。随着分红回购增持制度化、常态化深入推进，资本市场内生稳定机制有望进一步筑牢，助力A股长期健康发展。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Dividends, buybacks, and share increases progress steadily as A-share companies stabilize the market and boost confidence with concrete actions
headlines.summary_en: As A-share companies enter the semi-annual report disclosure window, cases of interim dividend distribution plans are gradually increasing; meanwhile, dense buyback and share-increase activities show a notably stronger awareness of rewarding investors. Analysts believe that expanded interim dividends, larger canceling buybacks, and big share increases conveying confidence, combined with related supporting policy tools, are boosting market confidence through concrete actions. With dividends, buybacks, and share increases becoming more institutionalized and normalized, the market's endogenous stability mechanism is expected to be further solidified, supporting A-shares' long-term healthy development. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.summary: 中信建投研报指出，本周市场风格由成长进一步向低位消费和价值方向切换，传媒、社会服务、商贸零售、美容护理、食品饮料及房地产等行业表现较强，通信、电子等前期强势板块明显调整；华为、人工智能、机器人、储能、新能源汽车及数字经济等概念涨停活跃度仍居前，周五市场情绪明显修复。AI仍是中期景气主线，但高位算力硬件进入分化阶段，资金逐步向AIGC、文化传媒、数据要素等AI应用端扩散，后续需更加关注业绩兑现和拥挤度风险。机器人受政策支持和产业化进展催化，仍具主题弹性。新能源围绕储能、新能源汽车、锂电池和光伏轮动，反内卷及供需改善逻辑延续。有色金属多重利好共振，工业金属开

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: AI remains a medium-term prosperity theme, but high-level computing hardware enters a differentiation phase, with funds gradually spreading to AI application segments
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research note: This week, market style shifted further from growth to low-valuation consumption and value sectors; media, social services, retail, beauty care, food and beverages, and real estate outperformed, while previously strong sectors like communications and electronics corrected notably. Concept limits-up activity remained high in Huawei, AI, robotics, energy storage, new energy vehicles, and digital economy, with sentiment clearly improving on Friday. AI remains a medium-term core theme, but high-level computing hardware is entering a divergence phase, with funds gradually shifting to AIGC, cultural media, and data elements on the AI application side; further attention is needed on earnings delivery and crowding risks. Robotics retains thematic elasticity, driven by policy support and industrialization progress. New energy rotates around storage, NEVs, lithium batteries, and photovoltaics, continuing the anti-involution and supply-demand improvement logic. Nonferrous metals see multiple favorable catalysts, industrial metals open

headlines.title: 中国债市多头情绪升温 10年期国债收益率再跌破1.7%
headlines.summary: 近期，国内债券市场多头情绪持续升温，长端利率迎来关键突破。行情数据显示，10年期国债收益率在1.7%附近震荡数日后，8月12日再次跌破1.7%关口，截至收盘，收益率报1.694%；与此同时，30年期国债收益率也同步走低，截至收盘报2.160%，处于年内低位水平。业内人士认为，本轮债市行情由宽松政策预期、资金面均衡偏松、机构资金接力加仓等多重因素驱动，但关键点位突破后市场多空博弈加剧，利率趋势性下行的有效条件仍待进一步验证。

headlines.title_en: Bullish sentiment heats up in China's bond market; the 10-year government bond yield falls below 1.7% again.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, bullish sentiment in China's domestic bond market has intensified, with long-end yields breaking through key levels. Market data shows that after fluctuating around 1.7% for several days, the 10-year government bond yield fell below the 1.7% mark again on August 12, closing at 1.694%. Meanwhile, the 30-year government bond yield also declined in tandem, closing at 2.160%, a year-to-date low. Industry insiders believe this bond market rally is driven by multiple factors, including expectations of accommodative policy, a balanced and slightly loose liquidity environment, and institutional funds adding positions in succession. However, after breaking through the key level, long-short competition in the market has intensified, and the conditions for a sustained downward trend in yields still need further verification.

headlines.title: 年内A股国有控股上市公司已披露超千起并购计划
headlines.summary: 以首次公告日作为统计依据，截至8月12日，月内A股国有控股上市公司（包括央企国资控股、省属国资控股、地市国资控股及其他国有企业）已披露54起并购交易计划。拉长时间线来看，今年以来截至8月12日，剔除交易失败案例，A股国有控股上市公司共披露1008起并购交易计划，其中256起已完成。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: So far this year, A-share state-controlled listed companies have disclosed over 1,000 M&A plans.
headlines.summary_en: Based on the initial announcement date as the statistical basis, as of August 12, state-controlled listed companies in A-shares (including central SOE-controlled, provincial SOE-controlled, municipal SOE-controlled, and other state-owned enterprises) had disclosed 54 M&A transaction plans this month. Extending the timeline, from the start of the year to August 12, excluding failed transactions, state-controlled listed companies in A-shares disclosed a total of 1,008 M&A transaction plans, of which 256 have been completed. (Securities Daily)
